data.name: Operation Tide
data.detailed_description:
Story: You and your forces are the only ones standing in the way of the Über tyrant & the dark gods.

Alternate history. diesel punk, Lovecraftian inspired story and aesthetics.

Retro pulp magazine cover art style with epic pulp adventure music score.

Command a strike force: This includes infantry, tanks, helicopters and mechs!

Tactical third person shooter: Command your troops with a wide FOV.

Battle hordes of enemies: Challenging varieties of enemies & creatures abound!

Real time strategy mixed with turn based gameplay: Capture territory and manage your operation's supply lines.

Procedurally generated levels: Semi-non linear approach to completing levels by calling in your drop ship where you want it.

Uncover the mysteries of the most remote places in the world and beyond...: What secrets will you uncover?

Customize: Upgrade your characters loadout and outfit your troops with the latest equipment by spending points you earn in combat.

data.short_description: Operation Tide is a tactical third person shooter RTS horde survival game where you command a company of soldiers in an alternate history of WW2. Embark on a journey to the remote areas of the world, fight the Dark Light Legion and eldritch horrors.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

content_descriptors.notes: This game has a alternate history World War II diesel punk theme that shares likeness to historical people, places and items. However all associated likeness to real people, items and events is fictional and not historically accurate. Their are themes of war and battlefield scenarios where soldiers engage in gritty warfare. Depictions are not realistic of this violence and "Operation Tide", uses a pulp art style that does not glorify war violence. The video game in question strives to show adventure, the bonds of fraternity amongst soldiers and the enduring spirit of liberty in a stylized way. Whilst honoring the pulp magazine art style of the early to mid 20th century.
